newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold prices slide, silver prices steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold prices slide, silver prices steady.

text.p: Indian gold prices fell in early trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
Gold was down by five rupees per 10 grammes on Tuesday,
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) slid by five rupees to 60,250 rupees after falling by 100 rupees on Tuesday,

Silver on the other hand held steady at reduced levels on limited inflows after customs on Tuesday night seized unofficial silver of about 2,000-2,500 kg. Silver was down by 15 rupees per kg on Tuesday, but was up by 65 rupees on Monday.
